text:
maya_csm: Heads-up: ZenithLabs onboarding - p95 on chat route ~220ms, token spend ~20% over forecast. Renewal due in 3 weeks; want low-risk perf plan.
rohit_perf: Can we get token-length distribution? Drives quant decisions.
manual: dashboard link: https://redwood/dash/zenithlabs - ~70% sessions <=300 tokens, 25% 300-900, rest >900.
anika_se: Proposal: client-side token estimate -> routing. <=256 -> compact-int8, 257-800 -> fp16-main, >800 -> fp16-long. Start with 10% canary on short-route.
rohit_perf: Recommend per-channel dynamic int8 calibration to preserve quality. I'll run model profile and expected cost/latency delta.
james_oncall: Ops: ensure KV cache compatibility across variants, tag traces by route, add quota guard for canary.
maya_csm: Customer is worried about hallucination on long outputs; confirm long-path stays fp16.
anika_se: Rollout plan: 10% canary for 6h, smoke checks every 5m, auto-roll back if error rate >1% or hallucination heuristic worsens by >4%.
rohit_perf: I'll prepare an eval of their top 1k prompts and produce concise CSV: p95, tokens, quality-delta.
maya_csm: Need a minimal SDK snippet for preflight token estimate for enablement call.
anika_se: Snippet for docs: function estimateTokens(s){return Math.ceil(s.length/4);} route = estimateTokens(prompt)<=256?'compact-int8':'fp16-main'
ops-bot: Checklist: security-review complete, perf-runbook pending, rollout-owner=anika_se.
maya_csm: Can we have artifacts by Mon EOD? I'll schedule a 30-min enablement Tue 11am PT.
rohit_perf: Confirmed - quant profile + eval by Mon EOD.
anika_se: Confirmed - routing config + SDK snippet + rollout doc by Mon EOD.
james_oncall: Added alert: canary-route-errors >1% -> page oncall.
maya_csm: Thanks team :rocket: I'll update renewal notes and ping customer.
